models_evaluated: causal forest with double machine learning

links.outcome: Model validated on two independent external facilities after training on six facilities
links.effect: Trained on six facilities (n = 2,425) and externally validated on two independent facilities (n = 2,460); concordant treatment CDAI response 33.6% vs 27.2% discordant (crude), ARD 6.4%, P = 0.002
links.quote: the model was trained on six facilities (n = 2,425) and externally validated on two independent facilities (n = 2,460).

unlisted_practices: Embedding guideline-derived safety rule excluding JAK inhibitors for patients with multiple cardiovascular risk factors into treatment recommendation model
Causal inference (double machine learning causal forest) for individualised treatment selection

screen.reason: Evaluates a causal ML treatment recommendation framework that explicitly integrates and tests guideline-derived safety rules (excluding JAK inhibitors in patients with high CV risk) alongside data-driven treatment selection on multi-centre retrospective cohort data.
